projects.name: JomDekan
projects.subtitle: A better place to learn. Together.
projects.description: A centralized academic resource and student collaboration platform for Malaysian university students. Learning materials, discussions, tutoring and AI-powered study tools come together in one moderated experience.
projects.detail: Built with a React and TypeScript frontend, a Node.js and Express REST API, and PostgreSQL. AI Resource Summary uses the OpenAI Responses API to analyze PDF, DOCX, image and text materials and produce structured study notes for PDF or DOCX export. Ask This Resource adds resource-grounded conversations with full-text retrieval, chunking, tool calling, persistent history and source citations.
features: Academic resources, multi-file uploads and taxonomy
University, programme and subject search and filters
AI study summaries with PDF and DOCX export
Resource-grounded assistant with citations and excerpts
Persistent conversations, caching and AI cost controls
JWT, refresh-token rotation, HttpOnly cookies and RBAC
projects.tools: React · TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind CSS · React Router · TanStack Query · Zustand · Axios · React Hook Form · Zod · Lucide React · Node.js · Express · PostgreSQL · pg · JWT · bcrypt · OpenAI Responses API · Structured Outputs · Tool Calling · Full-Text Search · PDF Parse · Mammoth · PDFKit · DOCX · Docker Compose · Redis · S3-compatible storage · Helmet · CORS · CSP · Jest · Supertest · Vitest · React Testing Library · Playwright · ESLint · GitHub Actions · Swagger/OpenAPI · Pino · Nodemailer
projects.skills: Software architecture, full-stack development, retrieval and search, LLM applications, authentication, web security, automated testing and technical documentation.

projects.name: FitWUs
projects.subtitle: Small habits. A healthier everyday.
projects.description: An AI-powered fitness and wellness platform that brings nutrition, workouts, hydration and activity into a personalized dashboard.
projects.detail: A full-stack wellness SaaS platform with an LLM-powered health assistant that uses nutrition, workout and activity information to support personalized wellness recommendations. The system combines relational data modeling, REST APIs, secure authentication and user and administrator roles.
features: Nutrition, hydration and physical activity tracking
Password hashing, rate limiting and security headers
projects.tools: React · JavaScript · HTML · CSS · Node.js · Express.js · MySQL · REST API · JWT · LLM API Integration
projects.skills: Full-stack development, database design, API integration, AI integration, prompt engineering, authentication and responsive UI/UX.

projects.name: Animal Image Classification
projects.subtitle: Teaching machines to see.
projects.description: A deep-learning image recognition application that identifies animal categories from uploaded images through an interactive web interface.
projects.detail: An image classification system using a trained neural-network model to predict animal categories. A Streamlit interface makes inference accessible through an interactive application, connecting model development with a practical user experience.
projects.tools: Python · TensorFlow · Keras · Streamlit · NumPy · Convolutional Neural Networks · Image Processing
projects.skills: Machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, data preprocessing, model training and model deployment.
